name: Coq au Vin (French Red-Wine Braised Chicken)
method: braise (Dutch oven / stovetop, ~45 min low simmer)
why: Verified 507 cal / 21.8 g carbs / 32.5 g protein per serving on the source page - mid-band on calories, well under carb ceiling. A classic chicken THIGH braise (bacon, mushrooms, carrots, red wine, broth), structurally low-carb with no rice/potato/pasta base. French cuisine broadens a catalog that already has no coq au vin. Scales cleanly to 14 as a Dutch-oven/braise batch. Red wine has no board home (feature for the pricer lane); brown gravy mix maps loosely to jarred-gravy but is flagged.
